sources.title: TDS Simulator: A MATLAB App to model temperature-programmed hydrogen ...
sources.snippet: In its first version, TDS Simulator is provided as a MATLAB App, which is made freely available to the community and provides a simple graphical user interface (GUI) to make use of TDS Simulator straightforward. As reported in the present manuscript, the outputs of TDS Simulator have been extensively validated against literature data.
